subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of safety responsibility toward yourself and others in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe rules, officiating basics, and honest self-calling using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply winning and losing without changing how you treat people in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving designing for inclusion rather than adding it afterward; correct it and explain why.
Connect giving and receiving feedback about performance, never about bodies with conflict during activity and how to resolve it and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Redesign a standard activity so that three people with different mobility, experience, and confidence profiles can all participate meaningfully in the same game, and defend each design choice.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Responsible Participation, Inclusion, and Etiquette?
